note.zh: 在 WorkBuddy（编码智能体 Harness）中以 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash（High 档 · 思考强度「高」）一次生成，全程未调用任何 skill、插件或 MCP，未使用自定义系统提示词。产出为单文件、自包含、通过 XML 校验的 SVG 插画（约 21 KB）：夕阳海边骑自行车的鹈鹕，含长喙与垂坠喉囊、折叠覆羽与深色飞羽、踩在脚踏上的蹼足、链条与轮组、湿沙镜面倒影、速度线与扬沙。生成后经两轮无头浏览器（Edge headless）截图核对，修复四处缺陷：前轮整组漏画；喙长与喉囊垂坠比例失真、覆羽被身体遮挡而不可见，重画翼部并调整喙与囊的曲线；一处渐变色标写成非法值（#96 9da5 已改为 #969da5）；后腿末端未落在实际脚踏坐标上。修复仅涉及几何与取值层面，未引入任何外部资源。
note.en: One-shot by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (High effort) in the WorkBuddy coding-agent harness, with no skill, plugin or MCP server invoked and no custom system prompt. The artifact is a single-file, self-contained, XML-valid SVG illustration (about 21 KB): a pelican cycling along a sunset seashore, with a long bill and a sagging gular pouch, folded coverts with dark primaries, webbed feet on the pedals, chain and wheelset, a mirror reflection in the wet sand, speed lines and kicked-up sand. Two rounds of headless-browser (Edge headless) screenshot review followed generation, fixing four defects: the entire front wheel was missing; the bill length and pouch sag were out of proportion and the coverts were hidden behind the body, so the wing was redrawn and the bill and pouch curves adjusted; one gradient colour stop had been written as an invalid value (#96 9da5, now #969da5); and the rear leg did not terminate at the actual pedal coordinates. The fixes are geometric and value-level only, and no external resource was introduced.

note.zh: 在 WorkBuddy（编码智能体 Harness）中以 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash（High 档 · 思考强度「高」）一次生成，全程未调用任何 skill、插件或 MCP，未使用自定义系统提示词。产出为单文件、自包含的 HTML5 体素世界（约 55 KB，1400 行；Three.js r160 经 jsDelivr CDN 引入，其余全部内联）：Perlin 噪声驱动的可滚动地形（实测高度 14–62，海平面 30）、6 种群系、14 种方块（程序化 canvas 贴图集）、第一人称 WASD 与指针锁定环视、重力与跳跃与自动上台阶、DDA 射线拾取的破坏与放置、按面剔除的区块网格与三通道材质（实体、自发光、半透明水）、昼夜循环天空着色器、雾、云层、快捷栏与 HUD。地形与神话造物均为固定种子的确定性生成，7 类造物按 112 方块网格单元分布：浮空神殿、世界之树、巨石环阵、通天塔、残破柱廊、持杖巨像、地下结晶石窟。生成后经三轮校验并修复两处缺陷：一是世界之树树冠的循环上界为非整数，树叶落在小数坐标上、写入体素数组时被静默丢弃，改为整数边界后该层切片方块数由 204 恢复至 639；二是「高地」群系的阈值 56 高于地形实际最高高度 52 而永不可达，且山峰振幅偏弱，将山体项由系数 44、指数 1.7 调整为系数 62、指数 1.5 后地形最高达 62、高地群系实测占比约 1.8%。已用本地无头浏览器（Edge 配 SwiftShader，WebGL2）实际运行并截图核对：169 个区块、无运行时错误；另用 Node 抽取纯逻辑函数复核高度范围、群系分布与 7 类造物的包围盒与方块数。
note.en: One-shot by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (High effort) in the WorkBuddy coding-agent harness, with no skill, plugin or MCP server invoked and no custom system prompt. The artifact is a single-file, self-contained HTML5 voxel world (about 55 KB, 1400 lines; Three.js r160 via the jsDelivr CDN, everything else inline): Perlin-noise scrollable terrain (measured heights 14–62, sea level 30), 6 biomes, 14 block types with a procedurally drawn canvas atlas, first-person WASD with pointer-lock look plus gravity, jumping and auto step-up, break and place via a DDA voxel raycast, face-culled chunk meshes with three materials (opaque, emissive, translucent water), a day-night sky shader, fog, cloud layers, a hotbar and a HUD. Terrain and mythic structures are deterministic for a fixed seed; the 7 structure kinds are distributed on a 112-block grid: sky temple, world tree, monolith circle, ziggurat, ruined colonnade, staff-bearing colossus and underground crystal cavern. Three verification passes followed generation and fixed two defects: the world tree canopy loop bounds were non-integer, so leaves landed on fractional coordinates and were silently dropped when written into the voxel array (integer bounds restored the layer slice from 204 to 639 blocks); and the highland biome threshold of 56 sat above the terrain's actual maximum height of 52 and was therefore unreachable, while mountain amplitude was weak, so the mountain term was changed from coefficient 44 / exponent 1.7 to 62 / 1.5, raising the maximum height to 62 and giving the highland biome roughly 1.8% of the surface. Verified by actually running it in a local headless browser (Edge with SwiftShader, WebGL2) with screenshot review: 169 chunks, no runtime errors; the pure logic was additionally extracted and re-checked under Node for height range, biome distribution and each structure kind's bounding box and block count.

note.zh: 在 WorkBuddy（编码智能体 Harness）中以 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash（High 档 · 思考强度「高」）一次生成，全程未调用任何 skill、插件或 MCP，未使用自定义系统提示词。产出为单文件、自包含的 HTML（约 49 KB，1281 行；Three.js r160 经 jsDelivr CDN 引入，机芯装配、材质与光照代码全部内联，不使用任何外部资产）：程序化装配的镂空机械表机芯，含珍珠纹主夹板、发条盒（内置可见的约 11.5 圈盘绕主发条与 34 齿棘轮）、中心轮与三番轮与四番轮与擒纵轮四级轮系（齿形与辐条镂空由 Shape 加 ExtrudeGeometry 生成）、瑞士杠杆式擒纵（擒纵叉含两枚红宝石瓦）、玫瑰金摆轮与 11 圈蓝钢游丝、轮系与擒纵与摆轮三块日内瓦纹夹板（含 Incabloc 式防震弹簧）、逐件展示的红宝石轴承、微弧蓝宝石镜面（折射率 1.77）、夜光时针对分针与蓝钢秒针、时标环、抛光精钢表壳与表耳、表冠与皮表带；影棚环境贴图用 PMREM 从程序化搭建的发光体场景生成（不需要 HDR 文件），配三点式灯光、ACES Filmic 色调映射、倒影地面与暗角。交互：自写轨道控制（拖拽旋转、滚轮缩放）、爆炸视图（按零件层级沿 Z 轴缓动分离）、18 个零件的悬浮标签与拾取高亮、点击锁定零件详情面板、自动旋转、机芯运行开关、镜面显隐与复位视角；摆轮按 4 Hz 摆动正负 135 度，擒纵轮每拍离散步进一齿，轮系与三根指针按传动比联动。生成后经三轮无头浏览器（Edge 配 SwiftShader，WebGL2）渲染核对，修复一组结构性缺陷：表壳原为实心圆柱，把整个机芯包在内部而只渲染出一块黑色圆盘（改为开口筒身并启用双面渲染）；主夹板为实心盘且层序在轮系之前，遮挡了全部齿轮（按真实层叠顺序重排 Z 轴：主夹板至发条盒至轮系至擒纵叉与摆轮至三块夹板至时标环至三根指针）；蓝宝石穹顶的球冠张角过小且 Z 位置埋在指针之下（改为按冠沿高度反解球心的高斯穹面）；齿轮辐条的镂空槽原以 absarc 生成，存在路径自交风险（改为四边形槽）。最终实测 18 个零件组、144 个可拾取网格、无运行时错误。另需说明：发光材料的夜光强度与展示用的指针转速为视觉参数，秒针在展示中约加快 10 倍以便观察轮系联动（已写入界面文案）。
note.en: One-shot by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (High effort) in the WorkBuddy coding-agent harness, with no skill, plugin or MCP server invoked and no custom system prompt. The artifact is a single-file, self-contained HTML page (about 49 KB, 1281 lines; Three.js r160 via the jsDelivr CDN, with all movement assembly, material and lighting code inline, using no external assets): a procedurally assembled skeleton mechanical watch movement with a perlage mainplate, a mainspring barrel containing a visible coiled mainspring of about 11.5 turns and a 34-tooth ratchet, a four-stage train (centre, third, fourth and escape wheels) whose tooth profiles and skeletonised spokes are generated with Shape plus ExtrudeGeometry, a Swiss lever escapement with a pallet fork carrying two ruby stones, a rose-gold balance wheel with an 11-turn blued-steel hairspring, three Cotes de Geneve bridges (train, escape and balance, the last with Incabloc-style shock springs), individually presented ruby jewels, a slightly domed sapphire crystal (refractive index 1.77), luminous hour and minute hands with a blued-steel seconds hand, a chapter ring, a polished steel case with lugs, a crown and a leather strap; the studio environment map is generated by PMREM from a procedurally built emissive scene (no HDR file needed), with three-point lighting, ACES Filmic tone mapping, a reflective floor and vignetting. Interaction: custom orbit controls (drag to rotate, wheel to zoom), an exploded view that eases parts apart along Z by layer, hover labels and pick highlighting for 18 parts, click-to-pin part detail panel, auto-rotate, a movement run toggle, crystal show/hide and a view reset; the balance oscillates at 4 Hz over plus or minus 135 degrees, the escape wheel steps discretely by one tooth per beat, and the train and three hands are geared together. Three rounds of headless-browser (Edge with SwiftShader, WebGL2) render review followed generation and fixed a set of structural defects: the case was a solid cylinder that enclosed the whole movement and rendered as a black disc (changed to an open-ended tube with two-sided rendering); the mainplate was a solid disc layered in front of the train and hid every wheel (the Z axis was re-ordered to the real stacking sequence: mainplate to barrel to train to pallet fork and balance to the three bridges to chapter ring to the three hands); the sapphire dome used too small a spherical cap and sat below the hands in Z (replaced with a Gaussian dome whose sphere centre is solved from the requested rim height); and the gear spoke cut-outs were generated with absarc, risking self-intersecting paths (changed to quadrilateral slots). Final measurement: 18 part groups, 144 pickable meshes, no runtime errors. Also disclosed: the lume emissive intensity and the hands’ demo rotation speed are visual parameters; the seconds hand runs about 10x fast in the showcase so the train linkage is observable, as stated in the on-screen copy.

note.zh: 在 WorkBuddy（编码智能体 Harness）中以 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash（High 档 · 思考强度「高」）一次生成，全程未调用任何 skill、插件或 MCP，未使用自定义系统提示词。产出为完整的 Vite + React 18 + TypeScript（strict）+ three.js 工程（19 个源文件、约 3600 行），模型、贴图与音效全部程序化生成，不使用任何外部资产。地图：Dust2 核心区域由矩形房间与走廊雕刻而成，含 T 出生点、CT 出生点、A 大、A 点、中门（含可推开且可穿过的门叶）、猫道、B 洞、B 点共 8 个区域，另有中路及中路连接 B 的走廊；用洪水填充验证 8 个区域彼此连通，且中门关闭时两个包点仍各自可达。角色：程序化类人角色，头、躯干、双臂（上臂加前臂）、双腿（大腿加小腿）各自独立几何体，持枪姿态并带行走摆动；CT 与 T 用 6 种不同配色区分。武器与命中：数据驱动武器表（AK-47、M4A4、AWP、Glock-18、USP-S、沙鹰、刀），主武器与副武器与近战三槽切换，AWP 支持右键开镜；命中按头、胸、腹、手臂、腿分区，爆头为身体伤害的两倍，含距离衰减与护甲头盔减伤；手枪局全员只带默认手枪且无护甲。回合与 C4：冻结期到进行期到下包到结算；安放 3.2 秒、爆炸倒计时 40 秒、拆包 10 秒（有头盔按 5 秒）；未下包时清空对方即获胜，已下包后 T 全灭回合仍继续（CT 必须拆包），CT 全灭或爆炸则 T 胜；持包者阵亡掉包，可被其他 T 拾取。AI：5v5（玩家加 4 名 AI 队友对 5 名 AI 敌人）。网格 A* 寻路加 string-pulling 平滑，状态机为巡逻、推进、交战、安放、拆包；视野判定基于地图遮挡（掩体高度会挡住低处视线），开火节奏按武器射速与点射，带反应延迟与瞄准误差；卡住时自动重算路径。HUD 与声音：准星、生命与护甲、动态弹药面板、击杀播报、常驻小地图（俯视轮廓加自己、队友、被看见的敌人与 C4 点位）、AWP 2D 瞄具遮罩、菜单与回合结算面板；音效全部由 Web Audio 程序化合成（AK、M4、AWP、手枪各自的开火声，以及换弹、脚步、开镜、命中、击杀、下包、拆包、爆炸）。验证（本机实测）：npm install（74 个包）后 tsc --noEmit 严格模式零错误，vite build 通过（662 KB）。另有三层自检：(1) 地图自检——8 个区域存在且连通、关门时包点仍可达、出生点可站立、包点判定正确；(2) 回合状态机推演 11 个场景全部通过；(3) AI 与角色单元测试（桩世界配合真实地图视线数据）全部通过——T 方 AI 自主从出生点推进 178 到 1 单位抵达 A 点，发现敌人后进入交战并开火 59 次，隔墙目标开火 0 次，持包抵达包点转入安放，CT 前往拆包 92 到 1，命中盒五个分区齐全，两阵营 6 种配色不同。浏览器端到端（puppeteer 驱动 Chrome 加 SwiftShader，真实时间）验证：指针锁定成功、连续运行 300 秒零错误、玩家移动使小地图光点位移、开火使弹药递减、冻结期进入进行期、回合跑满 115 秒并结算（比分 CT 1 比 0 T），第二回合正确发放护甲加头盔与 M4A4 主武器。生成后修复的缺陷：路径平滑原先只按共线判据合并路点，在绕门的阶梯状路径上会抄近道拉出穿墙的直线段（对 11 条关键线路采样校验时命中 14 次），改为带 0.5 单位通行余量的 string-pulling 后为 0 次穿墙；AiWorld 接口缺 c4Target() 却以强制转换调用，已补进接口；第一人称枪械视图模型过大遮挡画面，已缩放并下移。局限（如实记录）：受无头软件渲染（SwiftShader）性能限制，渲染循环被 0.05 秒的最大帧步长钳制，模拟时间约为真实时间的二分之一至五分之一，因此浏览器长时观测（300 秒）中未观察到 AI 之间产生击杀；AI 的交战与开火逻辑由上述在真实地图几何上运行的单元测试验证。
note.en: One-shot by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (High effort) in the WorkBuddy coding-agent harness, with no skill, plugin or MCP server invoked and no custom system prompt. The artifact is a complete Vite + React 18 + TypeScript (strict) + three.js project (19 source files, about 3600 lines); models, textures and audio are all generated procedurally, with no external assets. Map: the core Dust2 areas are carved from rectangular rooms and corridors, covering T spawn, CT spawn, A long, the A site, the mid doors (with door leaves that push open and can be walked through), catwalk, B tunnels and the B site: 8 areas, plus mid itself and a mid-to-B corridor. A flood fill verifies that all 8 areas are connected and that both bomb sites remain reachable while the mid doors are shut. Characters: procedural humanoids with separate geometry for the head, torso, both arms (upper arm plus forearm) and both legs (thigh plus shin), in a weapon-ready pose with a walk cycle; CT and T are told apart by 6 differing colours. Weapons and hit detection: a data-driven weapon table (AK-47, M4A4, AWP, Glock-18, USP-S, Desert Eagle, knife) with primary, secondary and melee slots and an AWP right-click scope; hits are resolved per zone (head, chest, stomach, arm, leg), with headshots at twice body damage, distance falloff and armour/helmet reduction; pistol rounds give everyone only the default pistol and no armour. Rounds and C4: freeze to live to planted to resolution; a 3.2 s plant, a 40 s fuse and a 10 s defuse (5 s with a helmet); wiping the enemy before the plant wins the round, but after the plant a wiped T side does not lose it (the CTs must still defuse), and killing all CTs or letting the fuse expire wins it for T; a carrier who dies drops the bomb for another T to pick up. AI: 5v5 (the player plus 4 AI teammates against 5 AI opponents). Grid A* pathfinding with string-pulling smoothing, and a state machine of patrol, advance, engage, plant and defuse; line of sight respects map occlusion (crate height blocks low sight lines); fire cadence follows weapon rate of fire and burst policy, with reaction delay and aim error; paths are recomputed when a bot gets stuck. HUD and sound: crosshair, health and armour, a live ammo panel, a killfeed, a persistent minimap (top-down outline with yourself, teammates, enemies you can see and the C4), an AWP 2D scope overlay, menus and a round summary; every sound is synthesised with the Web Audio API (distinct AK, M4, AWP and pistol shots, plus reload, footsteps, scope, hit, kill, plant, defuse and explosion). Verification (measured locally): after npm install (74 packages), tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors in strict mode, and vite build succeeds (662 kB). Three further self-checks: (1) a map check that all 8 areas exist and are connected, that both bomb sites stay reachable with the mid doors shut, that spawns stand on floor and that bomb-site detection is correct; (2) an 11-scenario dry run of the round state machine; (3) unit tests for the AI and characters (a stub world backed by the real map sight data) that all pass: the T-side AI walks itself from spawn to the A site (178 to 1 units), enters engage and fires 59 times once an enemy is in view, fires 0 times at an occluded target, switches to plant on reaching a bomb site with the bomb, sends CTs to defuse (92 to 1), exposes all five hit zones, and differs between the two factions in 6 colours. Browser end-to-end testing (puppeteer driving Chrome with SwiftShader in real time) verified pointer lock, 300 seconds of continuous runtime with zero errors, player movement displacing the minimap blip, ammo decrementing on fire, the freeze-to-live transition, a full 115-second round resolving to CT 1 : 0 T, and a second round correctly issuing armour plus helmet and an M4A4 primary. Defects fixed after generation: path smoothing originally merged waypoints on a collinearity test alone, which cut corners on the staircase-like detour around the mid doors and produced wall-crossing straight segments (14 sampled crossings across 11 key routes); it now uses string-pulling with a 0.5-unit clearance and samples 0 crossings. The AiWorld interface lacked c4Target() yet ai.ts called it through a type assertion; the method is now part of the interface. The first-person weapon view model was oversized and covered the frame, so it was scaled down and moved. Disclosed limitation: under headless software rendering (SwiftShader) the render loop is clamped to a 0.05 s maximum frame step, so simulated time runs at roughly one half to one fifth of real time; consequently no AI-versus-AI kills were observed during the 300-second browser observation. The AI engagement and firing logic is covered by the unit tests described above, which run against the real map geometry.
